### A present-day example · editorial commentary

Repeating a pronunciation exercise quickly may reproduce the same missed sound. Pausing to listen to a recording, identify the difficult part and try again more slowly changes what is being repeated. Persistence can include checks on the quality of repetition.

### A present-day example · editorial commentary
